Markets.title: Global Market: Chinese, Hong Kong stocks slip as AI shares retreat; energy stocks gain
Markets.summary: Chinese and Hong Kong stocks declined as investors took profits on artificial intelligence and technology shares amid weakening economic indicators. Conversely, energy stocks advanced due to rising Middle East tensions and higher oil prices.

Markets.title: Sigma Advanced Systems shares rally 5% on Rs 155 crore anti-drone orders; stock up 105% in 3 months
Markets.summary: Sigma Advanced Systems shares rose nearly 5% after securing Rs 155 crore in orders for its Indrajaal Ranger anti-drone system. The company's stock has surged 105% over the past three months, bolstered by an order book of approximately Rs 8,000 crore.

Markets.title: Gold slips below Rs 1.55 lakh/10 gm on MCX, but global prices extend gains. What’s next?
Markets.summary: Domestic gold futures on the MCX fell 0.6% to Rs 1,54,995 per 10 grams on Tuesday while international prices rose due to easing US Federal Reserve rate hike expectations. Investors are now waiting for the Fed's upcoming meeting minutes for further policy direction.

Markets.title: US Stock Market: Citadel Securities warns SEC rule change could hurt retail investors, market liquidity
Markets.summary: Citadel Securities warned the SEC that eliminating the order protection rule could harm market liquidity, price discovery, and retail investor protections. The market maker suggested alternatives, such as establishing minimum trading-volume thresholds for exchanges to maintain protected status.

Markets.title: Global Market: Japan’s 10-year JGB yield hits three-decade high on BOJ rate hike bets
Markets.summary: Japan's 10-year government bond yield reached its highest level since 1996 due to growing expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike. This increase was driven by rising global bond yields and renewed inflation concerns.

Markets.title: Sensex falls over 250 points, Nifty below 24,250 as Mideast peace hopes fade. More pain ahead?
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets declined for consecutive sessions, with the Sensex dropping over 250 points and the Nifty falling below 23,250. This downward trend was driven by fading expectations for a peace deal in the Middle East.

Geo-Political.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: Staff at an IVF clinic in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents by using unselected sperm and egg donors. Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using these wrong donors.

Geo-Political.title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
Geo-Political.summary: At his murder trial, a witness testified that "all hell broke loose" on the night rapper Tupac Shakur was shot. An officer also stated that Shakur refused to cooperate after being shot multiple times, telling police, "We'll take care of it."

Geo-Political.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
Geo-Political.summary: German authorities raided a secret police warehouse and seized dinghies and life jackets. These are the first raids conducted under a new law designed to crack down on migrant smuggling gangs.

Geo-Political.summary: Russia has warned the United Kingdom against supplying drones to Ukraine. In response, a British Ministry of Defense spokesperson stated that the UK stands "shoulder to shoulder" with Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: BBC breaks down Trump's latest shift on North and South Korea
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced that the United States will significantly decrease joint military exercises with South Korea. He justified this decision by highlighting his positive personal relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Geo-Political.title: Norway's king admitted to hospital and put on sick leave
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's 89-year-old monarch has been hospitalized and placed on sick leave due to a rare blood condition. He is one of Europe's longest-serving rulers.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the overall Southwest Monsoon rainfall deficit has decreased to 13%, the season has been marked by severe regional imbalances. These imbalances are caused by erratic shifts between heavy downpours and extended dry spells.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the removal of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) securing government contracts. Currently, MSMEs awarded orders exceeding ₹100,000 must provide a bank guarantee ranging from 3% to 10% of the project value.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey, India's overall unemployment rate fell in July. While joblessness increased in urban centers, it eased in rural areas.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Indian consumers are spending again. Can it last?
Data & Insights.summary: Indian consumer spending grew in the first quarter, driven by rural demand, premium products, and quick commerce. However, higher input costs and food inflation threaten to disrupt this ongoing recovery.

Data & Insights.title: Currency in circulation, ATM withdrawals, 10 countries, hinterland India… How UPI made a dent in the financial universe
Data & Insights.summary: India's UPI transaction value has surged to equal 70% of the currency in circulation. This rapid financial growth is now expanding beyond major economic hubs into the country's hinterlands.

Data & Insights.title: India’s $20 trillion economy by 2036: The 5 growth engines that could unlock its next leap
Data & Insights.summary: An Equirus policy report states that India can grow into a $20 trillion economy by 2036. This ambitious economic leap relies on five key growth engines: human capital, markets, services, governance, and currency.

India.title: Trump's Nod To India's Electoral System In Push For Mandatory US Voter ID
India.summary: Donald Trump praised India's election system for having nearly zero mail-in ballots and requiring valid photo IDs for every voter. He highlighted these practices while pushing for mandatory voter identification in the United States.

India.summary: The Bihar Board has opened the final registration window for the Class 10 and 12 annual exams in 2027. Eligible students must complete their registration by August 22.
